scope: Meter OCR feasibility research and benchmark specification for Trozy; not an executed comparison of new models.

evidence_policy.null_means: Not measured or not yet supplied; never interpret as zero or success.
evidence_policy.fit_and_priority_are: Engineering assessments, not measured accuracy scores.

current_environment_observation.method: Node os module and meterReaderStatus through scripts/run-project.mjs; no model inference
current_environment_observation.source_state: Working tree contains pre-existing modifications; this assessment does not commit or change application code.

baselines.name: Trozy fine-tuned PP-OCRv6 small det + rec
Trozy fine-tuned YOLOv8n OBB + VisionState wheels-v2

historical_evidence.nature: Reused development photos and controls over HTTP, not held-out accuracy data

historical_evidence.notes: Geometry selection is not full-string recognition. Rotations are correlated. Historical development evidence only.
Not real-Vietnamese-meter or zero-setup accuracy. Recognition loader filters some labels.

candidates.name: OpenOCR RepSVTR mobile
candidates.role: crop string recognizer; evaluate larger SVTRv2 separately
candidates.deployment: Official mobile ONNX and CPU inference documentation
candidates.training: Official fine-tuning and ONNX export documentation

license.weights: separate checkpoint-specific terms not verified in reviewed sources

candidates.main_risk: Requires correct crop, layout and calibrated rejection; not a wheel-carry decoder

candidates.name: baudm/parseq-tiny
candidates.role: crop string recognizer; NAR and AR decoding are separate runs
candidates.deployment: Author checkpoint; validate custom ONNX export/decoder parity before CPU deployment
candidates.training: Custom dataset and character-set training/fine-tuning documented

license.code: Apache-2.0 for PARSeq; reproduced third-party components have separate notices

candidates.main_risk: No detector or wheel-carry model; meter strings may not benefit from language context

candidates.name: PP-OCRv6 medium rec / det + rec
candidates.role: same-family upgrade control; recognition-only and full-pipeline variants
candidates.deployment: Official ONNX detection and recognition artifacts
candidates.training: Paddle training workflow; separate zero-shot from equal-data fine-tuning
candidates.main_risk: More capacity does not establish better layout or full meter-reading accuracy

candidates.name: microsoft/Florence-2-base-ft
candidates.deployment: Official checkpoint; community multi-graph ONNX conversion, not a drop-in single recognizer
candidates.training: Possible research path; no Trozy fine-tuning performed

license.conversion: Verify pinned converter artifact and runtime terms separately

candidates.main_risk: Full-photo resize can lose tiny digits; output text and region require independent verification

candidates.name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B
candidates.deployment: Official multimodal Transformers checkpoint; converted CPU artifacts need separate parity/runtime checks
candidates.training: Not assessed through a Trozy training experiment

license.converted_weights: Check exact conversion and runtime independently

candidates.name: HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-500M-Video-Instruct
candidates.deployment: Official ONNX inventory; GGUF available under ggml-org
candidates.training: Not assessed through a Trozy training experiment

candidates.name: EasyOCR English generation-2 CRNN
candidates.role: independent crop OCR or full CRAFT + CRNN baseline
candidates.deployment: Documented native PyTorch CPU; official ONNX path not verified
